pages.text:
Plutonium only ever becomes fuel: Plutonium Oxide has no other use.
- Depleted Uranium Dust and Oxygen in the Chemical Reactor make Depleted Uranium Dioxide.
- Five Plutonium Oxide and three Depleted Uranium Dioxide make two MOX Blend (a rod's worth of plutonium is ten).
- Press it with a Pellet Die, sinter it, and rod it in a Zircaloy Tube like uranium fuel.
MOX Fuel Rods run in the reactor like uranium rods, and in the fast reactor.
